rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to say that someone works hard.

example.english: We graft every day to support our family.
example.traditional: 為咗養起頭家，我哋日日都勤力做嘢。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 joeng5 hei2 tau4 gaa1 ngo5 dei6 jat6 jat6 dou1 kan4 lik6 zou6 je5

rows.note: Use this for corruption in public or official life.

example.english: He was arrested by the ICAC for graft involving public funds.
example.traditional: 佢涉嫌貪污公款，最後畀廉署拉咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sip3 jim4 taam1 wu1 gung1 fun2 zeoi3 hau6 bei2 lim4 cyu5 laai1 zo2

rows.note: Use this everyday noun for the effort or work put into getting something done.

example.english: We put a lot of graft into making this model.
example.traditional: 整呢個模型真係落咗好多功夫。
example.jyutping: zing2 ni1 go3 mou4 jing4 zan1 hai6 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 gung1 fu1

rows.note: Use this when joining a graft to another plant or tree so it grows there.

example.english: The gardener used this cutting to graft it onto the old tree so it could grow again.
example.traditional: 園丁用呢截枝嫁接落棵老樹度，等佢生返。
example.jyutping: jyun4 ding1 jung6 ne1 zit6 zi1 gaa3 zip3 lok6 fo2 lou5 syu6 dou6 dang2 keoi5 saang1 faan2

rows.note: Use this for illicit financial benefits or kickbacks, especially from a job or position.

example.english: There is plenty of graft in this job, so no wonder so many people want it.
example.traditional: 做呢份差事有油水，怪唔得咁多人爭住做。
example.jyutping: zou6 ne1 fan2 caai1 si6 jau5 jau4 seoi2 gwaai3 m4 dak1 gam3 do1 jan4 zaang1 zyu6 zou6
